themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Surge
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints exploded to 6 THIS WEEK compared to a 0.2-per-week average over the prior 8 weeks—a 2300% spike (z-score: 13.28)—suggesting either a sudden influx of unlicensed vendors or coordinated enforcement crackdowns that residents are reporting.
evidence: 6 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% increase, z-score: 13.28)
Vendor Enforcement complaints also spiked to 3 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 5.42)
Suggests either unlicensed vendors proliferating or aggressive enforcement campaign triggering resident complaints
reporting_angles: Interview residents and local businesses about mobile food vendor activity near transit hubs or parks in Throgs Neck/Co-op City
Contact DSNY/DOH enforcement to understand if coordinated vendor sweep is underway and what triggered the increase

themes_detail.label: Maintenance & Facility Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or Facility complaints jumped to 39 LAST WEEK compared to a 3.9-per-week average over 8 weeks—a 906% spike (z-score: 12.95)—pointing to widespread failures in public building or infrastructure upkeep across the district.
evidence: 39 maintenance/facility complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (906% increase, z-score: 12.95)
Aligns with repeated community board budget requests for park facility upgrades and DEP capital projects
318 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (228 alterations, 50 new buildings) suggest infrastructure churn and possible maintenance backlogs
reporting_angles: Audit which specific facilities are generating complaints: parks, libraries, public pools, parking structures, or NYCHA buildings
Interview Parks Dept or DEP about maintenance staffing and resource constraints in CD 210

themes_detail.label: Noise Complaints Sustained High
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints peaked 2 weeks ago at 29 (201% above the 9.6-per-week baseline, z-score: 4.25), and remain elevated in the context of 747 total noise-residential complaints over 90 days—a persistent quality-of-life issue affecting Throgs Neck/Co-op City residents.
evidence: 29 noise complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 9.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (201% increase, z-score: 4.25)
Noise-Residential is the 4th-largest complaint category overall (747 complaints over 90 days)
Noise-Street/Sidewalk also among top 10 complaint types (215 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Canvass residents to identify specific noise sources: construction (318 DOB permits suggest active work), nightlife venues, or traffic on Bruckner/Hutchinson River Parkway
Map noise complaints geographically—are complaints concentrated near active development sites or transit corridors?

themes_detail.label: Appliance Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Appliance complaints spiked to 13 TWO WEEKS AGO compared to a 3.2-per-week average (300% increase, z-score: 5.08), likely tied to heating season or broader Heat/Hot Water failures (797 complaints over 90 days rank #2 overall).
evidence: 13 appliance complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 3.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (300% increase, z-score: 5.08)
Heat/Hot Water is the 2nd-highest complaint category overall (797 complaints over 90 days)
Suggests heating system failures or landlord maintenance failures during peak season
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings or landlords are generating heat/appliance complaints; cross-reference with DOB violation and HPD compliance history
Interview tenants about unresolved heat/hot water issues and follow up with HPD on enforcement timelines

themes_detail.label: Litter & Street Condition Persistence
themes_detail.summary: Litter Basket complaints spiked 3 weeks ago (1500% above baseline, z-score: 8.66), and Street Condition remains the 5th-largest complaint category (734 over 90 days)—signaling chronic sanitation and street maintenance gaps in the district.
evidence: 4 litter basket complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score: 8.66)
Street Condition ranks 5th overall with 734 complaints over 90 days
Illegal Dumping (207 complaints over 90 days) and Unsanitary Condition (232) also persist in top 10
reporting_angles: Survey streets and parks in Throgs Neck/Co-op City to document litter, broken baskets, and street paving conditions
Query DSNY on sanitation staffing levels and basket maintenance schedule for CD 210
